verdict.rationale: Anthropic says its skills follow the Agent Skills open standard, which works across multiple AI tools and is meant for cross-platform portability. One community user reports using a skill directory with Codex by pointing AGENTS.md at it by hand. However, every documented install path is Claude-specific: the Claude Code `/plugin marketplace add`/`/plugin install` commands, Claude.ai, or the Claude API. Missing for 10: per-harness install instructions for Codex, Cursor and other agents, any documented installer or packaging for non-Claude agents, and independent corroboration that the collection works unchanged across harnesses.
